# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-21 from the 2026-11-21 Hub dump.

- 3,254,062 models tracked, 940,063 declare a base model, 973,446 parent links, 93,497 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
